title: Turn a supplied linear transported density into a passive affine current
statement: For C1 symmetric K(t) and supplied C1 mu>=0 solving partial_t mu+(Bx).grad_x mu=0 with x=(q,v,W), the displayed B,M obey B'+B^2=-M and tr B=0. With only Gamma^i_00=(Mx)^i nonzero, V=(1,Bx) is geodesic, A=mu V tensor V>=0 and div_nabla A=0. b=Lambda W^2/2 for Lambda>=0 has H_nabla b=Lambda dW tensor dW and A:H_nabla b=0.

requires: Supplied C1 nonnegative transported density and the specified auxiliary affine connection
provides: Exactly passive rank-one background for that connection

costs: Extra velocity and conserved W coordinate
Density acquisition and regularity remain separate
